title: Goodbye, Mallworld
content: I think someone posted recently about not having as many Mallworld dreams. I noticed this recently too, like since Thanksgiving…although sometimes I sense that I’m in Mallworld I can’t really recall my dreams, they are less vivid. Side note, I quit smoking weed about 2 months ago. I wonder if I’m sleeping better or if that has an impact on the dreams. Anyone else having this happen recently? I kinda miss it but happy to be sleeping better, I guess.
